completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: These nine sources print damage but no definite attack/save procedure. Core says Automatic or opposed as described; Final Spark separately says unavoidable.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: select an explicitly NEW source-local save and full/half outcomes. B: retain automatic damage without a save. C: select another fully specified source-supported resolution.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must decide separately for each identity. completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Cataclysmic Conjuration permits 10d10 of a chosen element in a 60-foot radius; Cataclysm permits 20d6 of a chosen element in a one-mile radius. Neither supplies the allowed element set.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: expressly extend Elemental Devastation’s Fire/Cold/Lightning menu to these two spells. B: select a different complete menu supported by actual damage identities.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: A is an available narrow completion, not inherited canon. Keep one chosen type and every printed die unless a distinct allocation is explicitly selected. Define choice timing before commitment and retained type through counters/Ready/Null/transfer. Do not grant a Mage Focus, elemental class branch, extra repertoire or a universal element taxonomy from this choice. Elemental Devastation’s separately printed per-enemy roll is not automatically inherited.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Core range 60 feet and native radius 60 feet are distinct quantities; no origin or creature/object recipient policy is supplied.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: a 60-foot-radius sphere at a legally perceived point within 60 feet. B: a self-centered 60-foot-radius effect. C: another fully specified geometry preserving radius.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose true 3D occupied-body intersection, origin line of effect and whether caster/allies/objects/terrain receive the event. Area recipients need not be individually perceived under the ordinary indiscriminate-area interface. Preserve full radius even where it surrounds the caster. A conjuration name alone creates no lasting mineable elemental matter or autonomous creature; any real residue needs its own explicit benefit and material lifecycle.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: The native effect is a catastrophic elemental event dealing 15d10 in a 100-foot radius, while Core assigns concentration up to one minute and the Summoning tag.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: a persistent catastrophic field with an exact initial event and finite later exposures. B: one actual event sustained/armed by concentration with a precisely defined discharge. C: explicitly replace conflicting concentration metadata with a single instantaneous event.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not silently collapse the spell to one hit, invent ten full pulses, or treat Summoning as an autonomous pet. Select timing and substantive ongoing benefit before writing examples. If using persistent pulses, expressly select cadence, same-family multi-owner exposure limits, attached companion phases, original expiry, suppression skips and owner-death behavior. Preserve the full 15d10 magnitude per selected legitimate damage event.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: No exact elemental menu, damage split, center ownership, mobility, environmental substrate or aftermath is supplied.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: a selected elemental manifestation with fixed location and one defined damage type. B: a complete multitype event with explicit allocation and physical aftermath.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve the 100-foot placement range separately from the 100-foot radius. State whether the event can be placed in air, underwater, enclosed or supported spaces; whether movement is possible; and what remains after concentration or dispelling. Do not infer physical lava, flood volume, harvestable matter, ignition or terrain restoration merely from catastrophic language. If these are intended benefits, author their real finite states rather than disclaiming them away.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: The source affects ALL ENEMIES in 100 feet for 12d8 elemental damage; it does not specify who identifies enemies or the center of that distance.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: expressly adopt the accepted perceived-and-affirmatively-hostile selection used by Meteor Spear. B: supply another definite information-based enemy-selection contract.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose origin and relationship to Core range 100 feet. Preserve all eligible enemies without an arbitrary numerical cap or discretionary post-roll omission. State whether enemies hidden from ordinary perception are included and how mistaken hostility behaves; a hidden objective allegiance detector is a new power and must be explicit. Fix type/menu and per-cast versus per-recipient RNG; do not import Elemental Devastation’s independent target dice silently.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Tear open rift is an explicit manifestation in an Instantaneous spell; no named destination, aperture, traversal, lingering hazard or return is supplied.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: a transient nontraversable rift that sources the full damage. B: a real traversable opening with a complete new destination, aperture and closure procedure.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A unless actual intent requires B; preserve the visible rift and its causal damage identity. Rift Spiral’s lack of a portal is a source-specific comparison, not proof for this source. If B, supply actual plane authority, body/cargo admission, clocks, blockers, current occupants and mandatory endings; no inferred cosmology equivalence or unlimited transport. Either way define source versus recipient suppression and post-discharge material state.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Rain of meteors deals 20d6 in a 300-foot radius, but damage types, mixed allocation and defense ordering are unprinted.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: A 300-foot-radius rain of meteors and Core range 300 feet leave location, vertical shape, roof interaction, environmental recipients and residue unspecified.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve the entire printed area and meaningful meteor rain. completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: The book prints a ONE-MILE RADIUS while Core range is 120 feet; range is not a substitute for the much larger area.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Each of four meteors has a full typed payload, but overlap, shared targets, allocation and damage event multiplicity are not specified.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Four declared impact locations may overlap cover, be airborne, or be changed by earlier impacts; the source does not supply a meteor travel speed or flight-intercept window.

Any deliberate structural or crater effect must be separately specified rather than borrowed from Arcane Apocalypse.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Nuclear burst of ARCANE AND FIRE: 15d10 does not define a canonical arcane damage type or whether 15d10 is total or each component.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Terrain is permanently scorched while Core duration is Until dispelled; no source states that dispelling restores consumed material or prior life.

Distinguish original clocks, independent fires, suppression, cleanup, overlapping scars and current matter identity.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Core gives range 120 feet but no burst radius, height, origin or propagation rule.

State creature and material membership, line of effect, partial terrain intersections, caster/allies and already-scorched areas. One cast must not duplicate inventory or replace a whole ground object merely because a small corner intersects. completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: All creatures IN SIGHT conflicts with Core range 120 feet, and says all creatures rather than enemies.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: 25d10 damage of RANDOM TYPES supplies no menu, distribution, seed ownership, allocation unit or equality across recipients.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: A random multitype packet can cross several immunity/reduction/transfer interfaces and eliminate the caster during an all-creature event.

State whether roofs block spheres or overhead arrivals, whether impact objects/structures exist, and what can actually intercept. A visual falling meteor need not be reusable ammunition. Any deliberate structural or crater effect must be separately specified rather than borrowed from Arcane Apocalypse.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Nuclear burst of ARCANE AND FIRE: 15d10 does not define a canonical arcane damage type or whether 15d10 is total or each component.
allQuestions.options: A: explicitly map arcane to an existing supported type and divide one total 15d10 pool. B: define a new arcane type with complete defense compatibility and a stated total allocation. C: another supported interpretation preserving both described components.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve both arcane and fire as substantive components; do not silently discard arcane or double to 30d10. Prefer reuse of a real type when justified, but no name-based force conversion is already authorized. Select exact dice allocation, per-type save rounding, reductions, resistance, transfer and one versus multiple damage events. Nuclear is fantasy source wording, not a grant of real-world radiation rules, fallout disease or an unbounded chain reaction.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Terrain is permanently scorched while Core duration is Until dispelled; no source states that dispelling restores consumed material or prior life.
allQuestions.options: A: instantaneous damage and durable physical scorching with a separately defined dispellable magical residue. B: an ongoing magical terrain transformation that ends on dispel, with exact preservation of independent physical consequences. C: explicitly reconcile duration to permanent physical aftermath alone.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose a meaningful scorched-terrain state and its effects on actual surfaces, vegetation, footing, resources and retained material. Do not substitute only a temporary cosmetic decal or restore prior HP/mass/inventory on dispel. Conversely do not invent endless recurring 15d10 or harvestable energy. Distinguish original clocks, independent fires, suppression, cleanup, overlapping scars and current matter identity.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core gives range 120 feet but no burst radius, height, origin or propagation rule.
allQuestions.options: A: a finite chosen point-centered sphere with an expressly NEW radius. B: another fully dimensioned burst preserving the source catastrophe and terrain effect.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Supply actual size rather than copying range into radius without explanation. State creature and material membership, line of effect, partial terrain intersections, caster/allies and already-scorched areas. One cast must not duplicate inventory or replace a whole ground object merely because a small corner intersects. The geometric completion should make the native large burst playable by software, not reduce it for physical-table convenience.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: All creatures IN SIGHT conflicts with Core range 120 feet, and says all creatures rather than enemies.
allQuestions.options: A: preserve all ordinary visible creatures without a 120-foot cap, explicitly reconciling Core. B: require both actual sight and 120 feet, explicitly accepting that narrower reading. C: another fully sourced range/vision reconciliation.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Decide openly; never silently make it enemies-only, a chosen target count or a camera-visible set. Define caster/self visibility, allies, mirrors, remote magical viewing, blindness, transparency and line of effect. Preserve genuine perception sources without treating True Seeing as infinite range or every image as an eligible creature. No unnamed other-plane search or omniscient hidden target detection follows.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: 25d10 damage of RANDOM TYPES supplies no menu, distribution, seed ownership, allocation unit or equality across recipients.
allQuestions.options: A: draw one type per damage die from a complete fixed menu and aggregate typed totals. B: draw a fixed finite set of types and divide the 25 dice deterministically. C: another exact distribution preserving genuinely random plural typing.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify uniform/nonuniform probabilities, with/without replacement, canonical type order and every RNG operand. Keep exactly 25d10 unless an explicit source change is justified. Determine whether type and damage are rolled once for all recipients or independently per body; do not reroll after defenses or let the caster choose favorable types. Define replay/save-load identity without conflating RNG visibility with player UI.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A random multitype packet can cross several immunity/reduction/transfer interfaces and eliminate the caster during an all-creature event.
allQuestions.options: A: one shared resolution snapshot, typed aggregation and one original-recipient event each. B: an explicit finite multi-event sequence with preserved original roots and declared ordering.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose exact mixed-defense extension, including equal-strength defense source ties. Complete an admitted simultaneous snapshot even if its own consequences kill the caster, unless an expressly selected source rule says otherwise. Do not let target order or initial self-damage erase other eligible recipients accidentally. Distinct transfer recipients, changed bodies, death replacements and Null disabled lifecycles must preserve their own existing scopes.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Sacrifice self is a required substantive cost/transition; Core supplies Action, Self, Instantaneous and V/S/F but no sacrifice timing or death predicate.
allQuestions.options: A: an explicit non-damage sacrifice paid at successful cast commitment, with defined treatment if countered. B: a conditional sacrifice transaction at successful resolution, atomically coupled to discharge. C: another complete source-faithful sacrifice sequence.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not reduce sacrifice to an affordable trivial HP payment or generic damage that Null makes harmless. Select actual death/body/life-state eligibility, whether already dying or nonliving casters qualify, and any exact would-die replacement interaction. Explicitly state whether prevention cancels the payload, is disallowed by this new cost, or has a defined alternative; no free discharge by survival loophole. Preserve original owner/root after actual caster death and legal remaining counter timing.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source says 200 damage in a 60-foot radius, UNAVOIDABLE; no type or exact defense overrides are printed.
allQuestions.options: A: unavoidable hit/no save, retaining explicitly applicable mitigation. B: fixed 200 actual damage with a defined source-specific bypass of mitigation. C: another explicit interpretation enumerating each bypass and retained defense.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose how strong unavoidable actually is. Preserve 200 and the full radius; do not casually turn it into 200-before-every-defense or omnipotent through-all-planes damage without addressing the phrase. Enumerate armor, flat reduction, typed immunity/resistance, damage prevention/transfer, temporary HP, Null, survival effects, cover, source suppression and countering separately. A bypass must be NEW and limited to this spell; no global rewrite of accepted defenses.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A self-centered sacrifice may remove the source body before the 60-foot area snapshot and may coexist with a prepared Ready hold or a transferred damage descendant.
allQuestions.options: A: retain the actual pre-sacrifice origin and original-caster damage-root snapshot, then resolve one admitted area transaction. B: another complete ordering retaining a real source origin and owner.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify the precise root snapshot, committed source identity, caster exclusion/inclusion, recipient/gear/body membership and how the paid sacrifice is distinct from damage. Existing Null expressly does not convert sacrificial costs; no new dealer may be created after sacrifice to evade the root snapshot. For Ready, respect the proposed ordinary paid preparation/target-at-release correction but identify the new sacrifice-specific hold and expiry decision. No Hunt resurrection exception or soul destruction follows merely from sacrifice wording.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Across this cohort, some sources expressly alter structures or terrain, while others only state damage. Existing generic damage snapshots do not alone define a catastrophic world update.
allQuestions.options: A: select an explicit recipient/material policy for each spell and resolve aftermath from its actual source operations. B: retain a bounded unresolved material-content hold for named missing profiles while fully authoring the supported behavior.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not turn a missing structure/terrain adapter into proof that an explicit printed effect is absent or complete. Preserve all requested radii and source benefits, actual material identity, geometry and destruction records. Once choices are selected, cases must include at least one meaningful positive structural obliteration and lasting terrain-scorch result, not just rejection examples. Keep source preservation, semantic acceptance, reference calculations, actual engine tests and numerical balance separate.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Large simultaneous areas, sequential typed defenses and real structural removal must not depend on camera/sector load or mutable target iteration order.
allQuestions.request: Bind each selected area admission snapshot, original-source root and true event multiplicity. Include actual distant and covered witnesses across the full5280ft Cataclysm radius, all four Meteor Swarm centers and a common overlapping body, and a caster who dies during a Ragnarök transaction. Define whether cover destruction changes only subsequent events, identify genuine support-loss FallMarkers and preserve whole object/partial material identities. No hidden actors or secondary damage may be admitted merely by re-running a mutated initial roster.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Real costs, source-supported ongoing effects and physical aftermath have different lifecycles; current authored Death Ward and Null do not generically cancel nondamage sacrifice.
allQuestions.request: Use exact current accepted damage/life/Ready/Null interfaces and fully acquired native actor sources. For Final Spark separately decide actual sacrifice timing, would-die replacement, source origin and retained damage flags, and paid Ready expiry without inventing a cheap survival loop. For Elemental Apocalypse prove the selected full concentration lifecycle and useful native event before expiry. For Starfire show selected15d10 total arcane/fire allocation and a genuine durable terrain state through dispel with unchanged prior death/material history.

requiredNewCases.requiredEvidence: Actual rank17 source/payment, selected elemental menu and full10d10/60ft radius with complete3D inclusion, real saves/defenses and caster/allied exposure.
True hidden/covered/body-edge witnesses, Ready type retention and source suppression/counter ordering, exact physical aftermath with no conjured material inferred by title.
Actual100ft radius/15d10 event and explicitly chosen concentration schedule, complete source/dealer/recipients and meaningful ongoing benefit before native60second expiry.
Real overlap/cadence, suppressed skipped exposure and concentration/owner loss, actual substrate/domain and retained aftermath without invented pet actions.
Actual hostile-perception roster of all eligible enemies within selected100ft geometry, full12d8 chosen elemental damage and independent current source qualifications.
Hidden/mistaken-hostile bodies, actual transient or fully defined traversable rift, suppression and source ending preserving custody without invented plane identity.
Actual full300ft radius meteor rain and chosen20d6 total typed allocation, complete overhead or sphere geometry and roof/cover witnesses.
Genuine admitted structures and cover mutation, initial versus subsequent recipients, actual damage/Null/transfer roots and explicitly selected finite residue.
Actual5280ft radius at valid chosen center, complete relevant sector/body enumeration including distant allies/foes/caster and real terrain/cover, exact20d6 chosen type.
Boundary/underground/airborne witnesses and real structural aftermath where admitted, immutable original snapshot and no load/camera restriction or duplicate event.
Actual12d10 force and a substantive source-defined structural obliteration with full matter/body/content/support records, genuine later fall transitions.

Partial structure crossing sphere boundary, real protected-material exception if any, no construct-body/armor misclassification, duplicated component destruction or mass/inventory deletion by grouping.
Actual selected class-school range reconciliation, four declared20ft spheres and exact10d6fire+10d6bludgeoning each, one body intersecting multiple spheres with chosen overlap/save/event policy.
Real cover and caster-body changes through selected simultaneous/ordered impacts, independent typed defenses and no post-result retarget, actual geometry unaffected by invented meteor travel.
Actual finite120ft placement/full burst geometry and selected15d10 total arcane/fire mapping, real typed arithmetic and substantive permanent terrain scorching.
True source suppression/dispel/recast and overlapping scars with exact physical versus magical fields, retained material/HP/death history and no endless damage/energy harvesting.
Actual caster/allies/enemies in chosen sight/range interpretation, full25d10 and every random type draw, source-qualified perception and per-body typed mitigation.
Caster death during admitted transaction, hidden/image/remote-view witnesses and genuine body replacement, stable RNG/event replay and no favorable type reroll.
Actual sacrifice eligibility and nondamage transition with defined survival replacement, pre-sacrifice origin/Null snapshot and full200damage/60ft explicitly enumerated unavoidable bypasses.
Countered/Ready/unreleased-expiry branches and actual death/corpse/history, independent defenses/transfer/tempHP/Null routing, no free discharge or automatic recovery/Hunt exception.

originalFutureCaseRequirementsUnchanged: After choices, create at least two complete current cases per identity plus every distinct new branch, with actual native class access, acquired repertoire, level, ability/PB, components, price/cadence and concentration/counter history.

Keep actual 3D occupied bodies, line-of-effect/cover, initial target snapshots, clocks, RNG operands, typed intermediate arithmetic, genuine source IDs, per-recipient events and exact final state. Include real Null and mitigation sources, not invented blanket defenses.

Cataclysmic/Elemental/Planar: actual selected types, allies versus enemy selection, whole area geometry, missing-versus-present elemental substrate, selected duration and genuine endings; rift comparison cannot create a transport feature without its selected full procedure.

Armageddon/Cataclysm: full300-foot and5,280-foot radius cases spanning genuine cover and distant actors. Software handles the entire scope; no offscreen omission. Distinguish independently admitted structures, terrain and later collapse.

Arcane Apocalypse: one substantive eligible structural obliteration and one partial-boundary/protected-material case, with occupants, contents, support, debris, retained mass and exact subsequent falling. Rejection-only coverage is insufficient.

Meteor Swarm: four actual impacts, at least one overlapping multi-sphere body, accepted typed arithmetic, range route reconciliation, declared centers and cover changing during the resolution; preserve the chosen overlap/event policy exactly.

Starfire: a real full burst and persistent terrain consequence, then suppression/dispel/recast with retained physical history. Prove a useful positive terrain effect without restoring destroyed objects or spawning free material.

Ragnarok: actual allies/caster/foes and vision/range predicates, complete random-type draws and all25dice, deterministic ordering, mixed defenses and recipient death/body replacement. Show repeated execution does not secretly reroll a favorable type.

Final Spark: actual sacrifice with real preexisting life/form/survival state and200damage, counter/Ready/expiry branches, original-root Null behavior, actual death history and no duplicate reward or unearned resurrection. Sacrifice and damage are separate auditable events.
These future vectors are obligations, not existing tests. Preserve every old source question/case; no new deterministic outcome is asserted before its open choice is selected.
